defmodule SearchIndexer.Config do
  @moduledoc "Configuration module for search indexing service"

  def base_path do
    System.get_env("SEARCH_INDEX_BASE") || "/var/lib/search_index"
  end

  def allowed_extensions do
    (System.get_env("SEARCH_INDEX_EXTENSIONS") || ".txt,.md,.html,.json")
    |> String.split(",")
    |> Enum.map(&String.trim/1)
  end

  def max_file_size do
    case System.get_env("SEARCH_MAX_FILE_SIZE") do
      nil -> 10_485_760
      val -> String.to_integer(val)
    end
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.PathResolver do
  @moduledoc "Resolves and validates file paths for indexing"

  alias SearchIndexer.Config

  def resolve(relative_path) do
    base = Config.base_path()
    candidate = Path.join(base, relative_path)
    normalized = Path.expand(candidate)

    with :ok <- validate_extension(normalized),
         :ok <- validate_containment(normalized, base),
         :ok <- validate_size(normalized) do
      {:ok, normalized}
    end
  end

  defp validate_extension(path) do
    ext = Path.extname(path)
    if ext in Config.allowed_extensions() do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_extension}
    end
  end

  defp validate_containment(resolved_path, base_path) do
    # Canonicalize both paths for comparison
    canonical_base = Path.expand(base_path) <> "/"
    # Check if the resolved path starts with the base
    if String.starts_with?(resolved_path, canonical_base) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    end
  end

  defp validate_size(path) do
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %{size: size}} when size <= Config.max_file_size() -> :ok
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :file_too_large}
      {:error, _} -> :ok  # File might not exist yet for write operations
    end
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.DocumentProcessor do
  @moduledoc "Processes documents for search indexing"

  alias SearchIndexer.PathResolver

  def index_document(relative_path, opts \\ []) do
    with {:ok, resolved} <- PathResolver.resolve(relative_path),
         {:ok, content} <- read_content(resolved, opts) do
      tokens = tokenize(content)
      metadata = extract_metadata(resolved, content)
      {:ok, %{path: resolved, tokens: tokens, metadata: metadata}}
    end
  end

  def index_batch(paths) when is_list(paths) do
    paths
    |> Task.async_stream(&index_document/1, max_concurrency: 4)
    |> Enum.map(fn {:ok, result} -> result end)
  end

  defp read_content(path, opts) do
    encoding = Keyword.get(opts, :encoding, :utf8)
    case File.read(path) do
      {:ok, binary} -> decode_content(binary, encoding)
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp decode_content(binary, :utf8), do: {:ok, binary}
  defp decode_content(binary, :latin1), do: {:ok, :unicode.characters_to_binary(binary, :latin1)}
  defp decode_content(_, _), do: {:error, :unsupported_encoding}

  defp tokenize(content) do
    content
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.split(~r/[\s\p{P}]+/u, trim: true)
    |> Enum.uniq()
  end

  defp extract_metadata(path, content) do
    %{
      extension: Path.extname(path),
      size: byte_size(content),
      word_count: length(String.split(content, ~r/\s+/, trim: true)),
      indexed_at: DateTime.utc_now()
    }
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.SymlinkExpander do
  @moduledoc "Handles symlink resolution for indexed directories"

  alias SearchIndexer.Config

  def expand_directory(subdir) do
    target = Path.join(Config.base_path(), subdir)
    resolved_target = Path.expand(target)
    canonical_base = Path.expand(Config.base_path()) <> "/"

    unless String.starts_with?(resolved_target, canonical_base) do
      {:error, :path_traversal}
    else
      case File.ls(resolved_target) do
        {:ok, entries} ->
          entries
          |> Enum.map(&Path.join(resolved_target, &1))
          |> Enum.filter(&indexable?/1)
        {:error, reason} ->
          {:error, reason}
      end
    end
  end

  defp indexable?(path) do
    ext = Path.extname(path)
    ext in Config.allowed_extensions() and not File.dir?(path)
  end
end

defmodule SearchIndexer.Web do
  @moduledoc "HTTP interface for the search indexing service"

  # Explicit allowlist of supported encodings; avoids converting arbitrary
  # user-supplied strings into atoms (potential crash/DoS and atom misuse).
  @allowed_encodings %{"utf8" => :utf8, "latin1" => :latin1}

  def handle_index_request(%{"path" => user_path} = params) do
    encoding_str = Map.get(params, "encoding", "utf8")

    case Map.fetch(@allowed_encodings, encoding_str) do
      {:ok, encoding} ->
        SearchIndexer.DocumentProcessor.index_document(user_path, encoding: encoding)
      :error ->
        {:error, :unsupported_encoding}
    end
  end

  def handle_batch_request(%{"paths" => paths}) when is_list(paths) do
    SearchIndexer.DocumentProcessor.index_batch(paths)
  end

  def handle_list_request(%{"directory" => dir}) do
    SearchIndexer.SymlinkExpander.expand_directory(dir)
  end
end
